Common Questions

EVERYTHING YOU NEED TO KNOW

Before booking your first lesson with Canadian Wheel Master.

Most students with zero experience are road-test-ready in 5–8 lessons. With some prior driving exposure, 3–4 focused lessons usually suffice. Rahul Manchanda will assess your level in the first session and give you an honest recommendation.

Yes! Pickup and drop-off is included with every lesson across Waterloo, Kitchener, and Cambridge at no extra charge. Just provide your address when booking.

Rahul Manchanda is a former MTO-certified DriveTest examiner — the person who actually evaluated road tests. He knows exactly what evaluators look for, the common failure points, and the specific routes used in the Waterloo Region. No other instructor in the area has this direct, insider advantage.

Absolutely. Lessons are conducted at your pace, with clear communication and zero judgment. Many students who failed with other instructors have passed after just a few confidence-building sessions with Canadian Wheel Master.

Lessons are conducted in a modern, well-maintained dual-control vehicle. Rahul Manchanda has an independent brake on the instructor's side, ensuring complete safety for all students regardless of skill level.

The fastest way is via WhatsApp at +1 647-512-9000. You can also call directly. Mention your current licence level, your availability, and your pickup location and a time slot will be confirmed promptly.
